messages:
Alex: FYI main CI turned red immediately after merge of PR #4217 (abc1234). smoke-gpu matrix failed - step `runtime-integration-smoke`.

deploy-bot: CI check failed: runtime-integration-smoke (gpu-smoke-matrix). Logs: https://ci.redwood/2880012222 — check details

Priya: I'm on it. @Sienna can you pause the autodeploy for this merge? want to avoid rollouts while we triage.

Sienna: pausing now, give me 30s. on laptop.

Mateo: quick glance — logs show `429 quotaExceeded` from gcp-storage during artifact download and then `CUDA out of memory` in kv-cache alloc. could be two separate issues.

Alex: hmm. commit touched runtime allocator in this PR. tagging @Priya and @Mateo for bisect if rerun flakes.

Priya: rerunning pipeline now — `./infra/ci/rerun --build 2880012222` (kickoff link: https://ci.redwood/runs/2880012230)

ops-bot: Rerun started by Priya — run id 2880012230

Sienna: thanks. if rerun passes, we can still quarantine that test and run a post-merge stress job before unpause.

Mateo: if rerun fails again let's bisect across abc1228..abc1234. I can start bisection and limit to smoke-gpu only.

Priya: rerun finished — ✅ passed (smoke-gpu green). I'm going to run two more repeats (3 total) to be sure.

Alex: good call. still add flaky label to the test and open a follow-up issue to repro on p3. I'll also add a rollback plan if repeats fail.

Priya: repeat 2 started -> passed. repeat 3 queued.

Priya: repeat 3 passed. marking this as transient for now. reopening ticket for follow-up: https://issues.redwood/INF-987 (assign eng-runtime)

Sienna: unpausing autodeploy. will watch the next rollout.

Alex: thanks everyone. closing thread — reopen if it reoccurs :thumbsup:
